blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savi Davison came out firing with 28 points to end PLDT’s woes, outlasting Capital1, 21-25, 25-21, 25-21, 25-21, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre. After struggling in their second straight loss with five points last Tuesday against Akari, Davison unleashed 23 kills, four blocks, and an ace laced with 18 excellent receptions and 10 digs. “I feel like we all kinda came into this game knowing that we had something to come back from. And it’s more ourselves than anything,” said Davison. “I’m glad that we pushed each other during practice […]... Keep on reading: PVL: Savi Davison, PLDT overcome Capital1 for first win
